description: This Java class defines a ScriptEngine for executing scripts within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages script context creation, invocation, and result handling, integrating with OFBiz services and utilities.

classes.name: ScriptEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine that executes scripts using javax.script, managing script context, invocation, and result processing within OFBiz.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Synchronously executes a script or script function based on the provided service model and context, returning the result or error.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Calls runSync and ignores its result, used for fire-and-forget script execution.
